description: Flanger from Surge: up to four tuned comb filters per channel, moved by an LFO, with a damped feedback path and an arpeggiating mode.

params.text: Picks what reaches the output: dry signal plus combs, combs only, dry signal plus arpeggiated combs, or arpeggiated combs only.
Picks the shape of the modulating LFO: Sine, Triangle, Sawtooth or Sample & Hold.
Sets the rate of the LFO that moves the comb filters, 0.0078Hz to 512Hz, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets how far the LFO moves the comb filters, 0 to 100%.
Sets how many comb filters run in each channel, 1 to 4.
Sets the pitch the lowest comb filter is tuned to, as a MIDI note from 0 to 127.
Sets the gap in pitch between one comb filter and the next, 0 to 12 semitones.
Sets how much of the comb output is fed back into the comb filters, 0 to 100%.
Sets how much low frequency is damped in the feedback path, 0 to 100%.
Sets the stereo width of the combed signal, -24dB to 24dB.
Sets how much combed signal is mixed with the dry input, -100% to 100%.
Nothing in the module reads this knob; the flanger has eleven parameters and the panel carries twelve knobs.
Scales both inputs before the effect processes them, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the effect, from silence to unity gain.
Switches the LFO rate from Hz to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by clock cv.

inputs.text: The left input into the effect; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right input into the effect.
Adds to the Mode knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Waveform knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Rate knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Depth knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Count knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Base Pitch knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Spacing knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Feedback knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the LF Damping knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Width knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Mix knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the flanger has eleven parameters and the panel carries twelve CV jacks.
Sets the tempo that tempo-synced times follow, doubling with every volt from 60 BPM at 0V, so 1V gives 120 BPM; with nothing patched the tempo is 120 BPM.

outputs.text: The left output of the effect; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the effect.

notes: the effect runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it delays the signal by 32 samples and reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
